g.text: 01 / BOOKME
SEP 2026 — PRESENT
Scheduling SaaS for provider bookings, payments and real-time slot availability on Stripe.
Kafka event backend cut booking API latency from 6s to <300ms; Redis locks prevent double-booking.
NODE.JS · REDIS · APACHE KAFKA · STRIPE
02 / YOUTUBE RAG ASSISTANT
AUG 2026 — PRESENT
Chrome extension that summarizes YouTube videos and answers questions grounded in the transcript.
LangChain RAG pipeline with Gemini embeddings + ChromaDB, served by FastAPI; multi-language transcripts.
PYTHON · LANGCHAIN · FASTAPI · GEMINI API · CHROMADB
03 / AGRICARE
JUN — AUG 2026
Farm management platform: crop care calendar, live mandi prices, schemes, expense & inventory tracking.
Dockerized on AWS EC2 with Jenkins CI/CD via GitHub webhooks; Prometheus + Grafana monitoring.
REACT · NODE.JS · DOCKER · AWS EC2 · JENKINS · PROMETHEUS · GRAFANA
04 / CODESPHERE
JAN 2026
Collaborative coding platform for pair programming and interviews: live code sync and video calls.
Sub-50ms sync with Stream SDK + Monaco Editor; Clerk OAuth2, Inngest workflows, sandboxed execution.
REACT · NODE.JS · MONGODB · STREAM SDK · CLERK · INNGEST
ALSO SHIPPED ▸ STUDYNOTION (EDTECH · RAZORPAY) · REAL-TIME ANALYTICS (SOCKET.IO) · SECOND BRAIN (TS · POSTGRESQL)
